title: Alternative dispute resolution.
bodyText: The commission may require the parties in any matter before the commission to participate in nonbinding arbitration, mediation, or other alternative dispute resolution process prior to the hearing.
bodyHtml: [§269-15.6]  Alternative dispute resolution.  The commission may require the parties in any matter before the commission to participate in nonbinding arbitration, mediation, or other alternative dispute resolution process prior to the hearing. [L 2000, c 263, §1]
